summary: The implementation covers most frontend and backend requirements with good fidelity. The backend includes game data models, CRUD operations, user profiles, ratings, comments, leaderboard, and admin authorization. The frontend implements all major pages (home, game detail, favorites, recently played, leaderboard, admin dashboard, franchise), authentication with Internet Identity, search/filter functionality, and a dark cyberpunk theme. However, the diff is truncated, preventing verification of the 500+ game seeding requirement (REQ-3), some backend query implementations, and complete frontend page implementations. Based on visible evidence, no clear hallucinated features were detected, but several requirements cannot be fully verified due to truncation.
